name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Exact version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery is not execution support. The exact legacy read tuple is connected-read-admitted and future mismatches fail closed; legacy general writers remain runtime-disabled. EasyEDA 3.2.209 has a separate six-tool utility-only catalog: API reference, local discovery, status, bounded Math/Unit/Environment operations and ordinary application launch. Its design, project-opening, native/private, Save and design-recovery routes are not registered; connected validation is pending. Older 3.2.206 profiles retain eligible symbol metadata and schematic-title workflows plus separate disposable validation routes, each requiring exact admission, original ownership and complete persistence proof. They do not transfer to 3.2.209. General writers and the new ratline capture integration remain unfinished. Offline startup diagnostics report installation metadata without execution or automatic migration. Ordinary startup uses the existing profile, may restore tabs and persist data, and does not prove isolation. Ambiguous attempts remain consumed; normal closure, original root/Job termination and supervision settlement are separate. No unrestricted JavaScript, arbitrary command, Save/Discard choice, force exit or blind retry is exposed. Historical journals cannot recreate ownership. Consult the skills and coverage inventory for exact scope.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
